outcome: Knowledge of anesthesia for cesarean section
Attitude toward anesthesia for cesarean section
Perception of anesthesia for cesarean section
Preference for regional vs general anesthesia
cohort: The participants were consenting pregnant women attending Aminu Kano Teaching Hospital.
finding: The study revealed high knowledge and awareness of anesthesia for cesarean section among pregnant women, with regional anesthesia being preferred over general anesthesia.
